verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the concrete acceptance condition that the digital layout remain balanced and function as two-page flipbook spreads.

value_updates.page_count_parity: The page count must be even, meaning divisible by 2.

verdicts.decision_note: The even-page-count rule is an implementation-relevant acceptance condition for two-page spreads; upload-file selection belongs to the narrower Heyzine upload-file Requirement.
The message changes who uploads the final PDF through Heyzine, not the page structure or two-page spread compatibility.

missing_event_candidates.description: The instruction to upload the pages version rather than the spread-preview version belongs to the narrower Heyzine upload-file selection Requirement.
The client changes the Heyzine workflow by taking responsibility for manually uploading the final PDF through the client's white-label account.
